delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.trashNote: It goes to the Trash first. An admin can restore it or delete it for good.
delete.openWorkTitle: Their open work needs a new owner

body.client: The client disappears from every list, report and the portal, together with everything that belongs to it.
body.client_user: They lose access to the portal for this company.
body.member: They lose access to the agency app. Their work history stays.
body.package: The package can no longer be assigned.
body.request_type: Clients can no longer submit this type of request.
body.workflow_template: The template can no longer be used to convert requests.
body.request: The request disappears for the agency and the client, with its tasks and deliverables.
body.task: The task disappears from boards and lists, with its subtasks.
body.folder: The folder and everything in it disappear.
body.file: The file disappears for the agency and the client.
body.deliverable: The deliverable and all its versions disappear.
body.deliverable_version: This version disappears; earlier versions stay.
body.comment: The message disappears from the conversation.
body.lead: The lead disappears from the leads list, search, follow-ups and the sales dashboard, with its activities. Deals that came from it stay.

count.portal_users: {count, plural, one {# portal user} other {# portal users}}

blocker.requests: {count, plural, one {# request uses} other {# requests use}} this type — turn it off instead, or delete them first.
blocker.client_packages: {count, plural, one {# client has} other {# clients have}} it this period.
blocker.tasks: {count, plural, one {# open task was} other {# open tasks were}} created from it.
blocker.sent_to_client: It was sent to the client, so it stays in the approval history.

work.tasks: {count, plural, one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
work.clients: {count, plural, one {# client they manage} other {# clients they manage}}
work.deals: {count, plural, one {# open deal} other {# open deals}}

bulk.title: Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}?
bulk.body: They go to the Trash, each as its own entry, so you can restore any of them.
bulk.done: {count, plural, one {# item moved} other {# items moved}} to Trash

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted items stay here until someone restores them or deletes them for good.
trash.emptyHint: Deleted clients, leads, requests, tasks, files and more show up here.
trash.purgeBody: This can't be undone. Files are removed from storage too.
trash.emptyTrashBody: Everything you're allowed to delete for good is removed permanently, including files. This can't be undone.
trash.emptied: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} deleted forever

reset.title: Data management
reset.description: Back up your data, or clear demo or test data before you start real work. Super Admin only.
reset.backupHint: A ZIP with every table of your agency as JSON and a list of stored files.

demo.title: Delete demo data only
demo.body: Removes every demo record (clients, people, leads, deals, templates…) and their files. Your own records stay.

operational.title: Delete all operational data
operational.body: Clients, portal users, requests, tasks, deliverables, files, messages, sales records, notifications, activity and time entries. Keeps the organization, the team, roles and permissions, departments, request types, workflow templates, packages and settings.

factory.title: Factory reset
factory.body: Everything except your own Super Admin account and the organization record. Roles, departments and defaults are recreated.

reset.succeeded: Done. {files, plural, =0 {No files removed.} one {# file removed.} other {# files removed.}}
reset.failed: The reset failed and nothing was deleted: {error}
reset.lockHint: After go-live, lock this screen so nobody can wipe data by accident. Unlocking needs your password.
